subject.title: [Feature]: Granular session visibility — split tools.sessions.visibility into per-capability knobs

question: Should OpenClaw add a per-capability `tools.sessions.visibility` object, or should cross-agent send/read/list separation be handled by the existing A2A allowlist and per-agent visibility proposals?
rationale: This changes the transcript privacy boundary and public config shape, and current related proposals overlap the same session authorization surface without one settled model.

options.title: Approve unified capability object
options.body: Adopt a backward-compatible object form for send, history, list, and metadata after reconciling it with allowlist, per-agent, sandbox, and A2A semantics.

options.title: Use A2A and allowlist scopes
options.body: Make the open allowlist or per-agent A2A proposals canonical if maintainers decide they satisfy the send-without-read privacy goal better than per-capability flags.

options.title: Defer until related PRs settle
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical design question while active adjacent PRs are reviewed or closed.

recommendation.title: Approve unified capability object
recommendation.body: Adopt a backward-compatible object form for send, history, list, and metadata after reconciling it with allowlist, per-agent, sandbox, and A2A semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history is strongest on the public session-tool config, schema, docs, and security scoping boundary this decision would change.
